data.gender_notes: Timotheus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Timotheus means 'honoring God'. This name was borne by several figures in the New Testament, including Timothy, who was one of Paul's companions and a leader in the early Christian church. The name Timotheus carries the meaning “Honoring God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Timotheus usually hope their child will grow to embody honoring god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Timotheus total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Timotheus has significant historical and cultural impact in Christianity. It was borne by several early Christian figures, most notably Timothy, who became a close companion and aide to the apostle Paul. This name came to symbolize dedication to the teachings and mission of Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: Timotheus is a name deeply rooted in Christian spirituality. It symbolizes a commitment to honor and serve God, as reflected in its Greek meaning. This name is a reminder of the importance of seeking spiritual growth and fulfilling God's will in one's life. Throughout history, individuals named Timotheus have served as role models for living a life dedicated to God, inspiring future generations to do the same.
